To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the one-loop self-energys of the W, Z bosons have been computed in a nonlinear electroweak theory with a gauge group that is nonlinearly realized in the Higgs sector, that the theory is unitary, and that the results have been compared to the standard electroweak case.

we have evaluated at one loop the electroweek self-energies with a nonlinearly realised gauge group, we have estimated the parameters of the model from a simplified fit to leptons and gauge-bosons data, we have checked physical unitarity, we have shown that the model is free from infrared divergences and we have provided the D-dimensional regularized amplitudes as a reference for future work.
the electroweek theory in the nonlinear realization of the gauge group is renormalizable and the physical amplitudes are finite.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: the electroweek theory in the unitary gauge, the renormalization procedure, the renormalized amplitudes, and the physical observables.
the study of the one loop electroweak corrections to the gauge boson self-energies.
the study of one loop self-energies of the W, Z bosons in a nonlinear realization of the electroweek model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model is viable at one loop.
the model under investigation is renormalizable and unitary, with the only drawback that the gauge bosons masses are not physical.
the electroweaks model with nonlinearly realized gauge symmetry is a consistent and well-defined quantum field theory.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the model has a good behavior at the quantum level.
the electroweek model with a nonlinear realization of the gauge group is a viable model for the description of the electroweaks interactions.
the electroweaks model with nonlinearly realized gauge symmetry can be used as a valid model to fit the electroweek data at the same level of accuracy of the standard model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a nonlinearly realized electroweak theory can be made consistent at one-loop order.
the electroweaks theory with nonlinearly realized symmetry is viable and that the one-loop self-energy amplitudes are finite.
the electroweek model with a nonlinear gauge group is renormalizable at one loop.
